title: spec.skill.md Phase 9 git_commit omits run artifact files from commit
description: After Phases 7–8 write run artifacts to disk — signal catalogue entries (.moeb/signals/catalogue/), the run signals file (.moeb/signals/<run_id>.signals.json), the signals index (.moeb/signals/index.md), the metrics file (.moeb/metrics/<run_id>.metrics.json), and the run file (.moeb/runs/<timestamp>_spec_*.json) — Phase 9 calls git_commit with only spec_path and readme_path. All run artifact files are left as uncommitted modifications in the working tree, requiring a manual follow-up commit to capture them.
proposed_resolution: Update spec.skill.md Phase 9 to include the run artifact paths in the git_commit call alongside spec_path and readme_path, or add a second git_commit invocation after Phase 8 that stages the signals, metrics, and run file directories. Alternatively, extend the git_commit tool to accept an additional_paths array and update the spec skill to pass the run artifact paths.
